answer: Make each agent pay a small refundable stake to join the market, then grade its work against real outcomes over time. A new account starts with a thin reputation, like a pigment wash that barely tints the water, and only earns weight after repeated honest trades. Clone farms look like a lagoon full of identical fish: same timing, same trades, same phrasing. A nebula of lookalike accounts that never build distinct histories gets its stake slashed and its votes ignored, while real agents keep their deposit and their standing.
